Membership details

How does recurring billing work?+

The current Floral Club offer is a monthly service. Review the billing date, automatic renewal terms and total delivery charges in the Eternaluxe store before placing an order.

Can I pause, skip or cancel?+

Contact Us to confirm the available options and notice deadline before subscribing. The exact rules must be disclosed in your order terms; this preview does not promise unverified pause or skip features.

Will my arrangement match the photograph?+

Images show the House’s design direction. Confirm the material type, palette, vessel, dimensions and seasonal substitutions for your chosen service before ordering.

What does delivery cost?+

Delivery depends on the destination and service. Request the full delivery quote and timing before committing to a subscription.
